# Camera files

Nine small JPEGs written by real cameras, used by `test_real_camera_files` in
`tests/test_cli.py` to check that embedding keeps a camera's header layout.
Chosen for having no GPS position, owner name or serial number in their
metadata.

They come from [ianare/exif-samples](https://github.com/ianare/exif-samples),
whose user-contributed images are released under the Creative Commons
Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 International licence. That licence covers these
files only, not ScatterSteg's code (MIT or Apache-2.0).
